note: Teaching schedule — the fixed weekly timetable. Edit this file to change it; the front page reads it every day. Times are local, 24h. Days: Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat Sun.

rest_day.note: A day with all the sections is a rest day (Harry, 6 Nov 2026): the Google events of the day matching this are counted.

periods.note: the regular day: when each period starts, in minutes from midnight (8:30, 10:25, 12:50, 2:05); a special schedule names periods, and a class is matched to its period by its regular start
